name: BENEFIT JAPAN Co.,LTD.
summary: BENEFIT JAPAN Co., Ltd. operates in Japan's telecommunications industry, offering MVNO (virtual mobile network operator) services, mobile internet solutions, support, and fiber optic internet bundled with content. It also works as a sales agency, reseller and house vendor and distributes chilled and heated mineral water. The company dates from 1996 and has its head office in Osaka, Japan.
